comments.body:
CI is sitting in \`action_required\` (fork-contributor approval gate) — could someone press "Approve and run workflows"?

Local verification while it's waiting:
\`\`\`
$ .venv/bin/python -c "import ragas"
ragas imported OK
$ .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/unit -q
776 passed, 105 skipped  (pre-existing gaps are unrelated missing optional deps from make install-minimal: sacrebleu, rapidfuzz, llama_index, git)
$ .venv/bin/python -m ruff check src/ragas/llms/base.py tests/unit/test_import.py
All checks passed!
$ PYRIGHT_PYTHON_FORCE_VERSION=latest .venv/bin/pyright -p pyproject.toml src/ragas/llms/base.py
0 errors, 0 warnings, 0 informations
\`\`\`

Separately: the "Claude Docs Check" failure isn't from this diff — its \`pull_request_target\` workflow refuses to check out fork PR code (\`Refusing to check out fork pull request code from a 'pull_request_target' workflow\`), the same class of issue #2606 addressed but apparently not fully for this workflow. Flagging in case it's useful, not something I'm trying to fix here.

Hi, a gentle ping on this one. The red `check-docs` job is the workflow refusing to check out fork code under `pull_request_target`, not a failure in this change; the fix still applies cleanly to main. Happy to adjust anything.
